title: Jurisdictions (membership reference)
description: Symbolic blocs EU and UN (members + timezone) plus per-country IANA zones and ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (uppercase ISO alpha-2 key, timezone + country_code_3). EU is an exceptionally reserved ISO 3166-1 code used here as a membership bloc, not a country timezone row; UN is a symbolic bloc (not an ISO country). Switzerland is keyed CH only (no lowercase ch bloc). providers.json resolves operational timezone via jurisdictions[COUNTRY].timezone.

unit.description: Human-readable encoding hints for this file and related porto-data fields. Required: country_code (alpha-2 in jurisdictions.*.members and uppercase country keys) and country_code_3 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 on per-country rows). Other keys are optional documentation (e.g. region_code, date); values are short standard names.

jurisdictions.description: Keys: EU, UN (blocs with members + timezone). Other uppercase ISO alpha-2: timezone + country_code_3. Framework tag CH resolves via country entry CH, not a ch bloc.

jurisdiction_bloc.description: Member list and default IANA zone for symbolic framework tags EU or UN.

members.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes in this bloc

jurisdiction_country.description: Primary legal/operational IANA zone and ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 for this country code (same key as ISO alpha-2).

country_code_3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (one-way companion to the alpha-2 map key)
